description: How many seats each party holds in the House of Commons on a given date, with totals and the number of women MPs, from the UK Parliament Members API state of the parties. Answers "how many MPs does each party have?" after defections and by-elections. Shows the largest party's margin as simple arithmetic; it does not compute the official working majority. (cost: 1 credit)

date.description: string, optional, YYYY-MM-DD, not in the future; default today (UTC)

name: commons_party_seats
